subject.title: refactor(slack): drive progress drafts through the shared compositor

question: Should fresh Slack progress finals, compact draft receipts, and the new public compositor snapshot/receipt API become the permanent shared channel contract?
rationale: The patch is more than an internal Slack refactor: it changes Slack delivery semantics and exposes new public plugin SDK surface while altering a helper used by sibling channels.

options.title: Sponsor after proof
options.body: Approve the shared direction after live Slack proof and explicit Discord/Telegram compatibility coverage are added.

options.title: Keep it Slack-local
options.body: Retain the user-visible Slack behavior but avoid public SDK and shared merge changes that are not required by other channels.

options.title: Pause the behavior change
options.body: Limit this PR to behavior-neutral compositor migration and discuss fresh finals and receipts separately.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after proof
recommendation.body: Approve the shared direction after live Slack proof and explicit Discord/Telegram compatibility coverage are added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work owns the closest Slack progress-rendering and native task-card surface.
